newsitem.title: USA: US adj retail sales up 0.1 pct w/e July 26-Redbook.
newsitem.headline: US adj retail sales up 0.1 pct w/e July 26-Redbook.

text.p: U.S. seasonally adjusted retail sales rose 0.1 percent in the three weeks of fiscal July versus June, according to the Lynch, Jones & Ryan Inc Redbook Retail Sales Index.

The index rose 8.3 percent compared to the same month a year ago, the report said. Adjusted retail sales advanced 8.6 percent in the week ended July 26, compared with the same week a year ago, it said.
"The week saw a continuation of the seasonal demand that has driven sales throughout the month," the report said. It also helped in comparison to a cool summer a year ago, the report added.
